label: Nested records from one supplier audit update by conditional likelihood
paraphrase: Given a matching prefix of positive finite-class likelihood for the same recipient, reobserving the same or a shorter matching prefix has conditional likelihood one. Extending to a longer matching prefix has conditional finite-class likelihood equal to its prior mass divided by the prior mass of the already observed prefix. For positive finite-class weight and both likelihoods positive, dividing the old endless-to-sourced odds by this conditional likelihood gives the new odds, since the deterministic endless world matches both records.
